_comment: v2 pretrain (443M) on a free Kaggle T4 16GB (or P100): fp16 autocast + GradScaler (no fast bf16 pre-Ampere), gradient checkpointing and chunked cross-entropy to fit 4×1024 per micro-batch. 4×1024×24 = 98k tokens/step, same as the A100 config, so both configs share one checkpoint (same out_ckpt / hf_repo) and can alternate between sessions. Muon's Newton-Schulz runs in bf16 (emulated on T4, once per optimizer step): smoke-test 20 steps before a long session.
